name: Bam and its Cultural Landscape
description: Bam sits in the desert on the southern edge of Iran's high plateau, where an oasis has supported life for roughly 2,500 years. Its centrepiece is Arg-e Bam, a medieval fortified town built of layered mud, which flourished as a silk and cotton trading hub on busy caravan routes. Ancient underground qanāt canals still water the surrounding palm groves.
